notes.title: Update: v.EA.0.3.1 Lock and load!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re thrilled to roll out some major updates this time! From overhauled controls to fresh visuals, here’s what’s new:

[b]Controls
[/b]
[b]Target Locking:[/b]
You can now lock onto enemies by pressing R3. Switch between targets by flicking the R button.
While locked on, most attacks—including firearms—will automatically aim at the locked target.
Some moves, like the forward slash, still rely on your L3 directional input for precision.

[b]Double Jumping:
[/b]After defeating the Succubus Boss, you’ll unlock Double Jump, allowing you to leap mid-air.
Healing during Overclock mode is now available by default.
[b]Stage Rework
[/b]The Jungle Stages have been completely replaced with the newly designed Island, including an updated boss stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/dc5351a4e63d8f5244d0580a7086d482087c93a7.png[/img]
[b]Minor Tweaks
[/b]Gameplay Adjustments:

Running speed: slightly reduced.
Katana dash: slightly shorter range.
Pistol: lower fire rate, but it now packs a bigger punch.
Boss: Savager has received some balance adjustments.
UI & Camera:

Minor tutorial UI refinements.
Camera angles have been fine-tuned for smoother gameplay.
Thank you so much for your patience and support! Development might be moving a bit slow, but I promise the project is very much alive and kicking. More updates are coming soon—stay tuned!

Let’s keep building this together. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/15f669fc5faa227b09944975f4a9e117545cd86b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update EA v.0.3.0
notes.content:
Hi all,

I know it has been a while since the last update; I have some fascinating news!

I spent most of my time during this period finding talents to join me and, wow, I am no longer working on this alone! 

We now have world-class artists, animationists, and musicians!  The team is now 7 people. We all work on this part-time.  And things are going smoothly.   Unfortunately, good things take time, not much of the work will be shown in this update.  But I am sure it is coming!


Update log:
Major:
- Improved parry timing, now it is more similar to other games having parry mechanism
- Increased enemy knocked-up air time for better air combo
- Enemies not holding block stance if they have shielding on during an attack
- Less stun lock from minions
- Now you can dash during wall run
- Boss move-set update D#02 and D#04 (This is just the beginning of the new teamwork, more is coming)
Quality of life
- Conversation mode now has a slightly smaller avatar size
- Camera angle is tuned for a better experience
- Camera-blocking objects now turn back visibility faster


Cheers!!!

Brain Hack Magic

notes.title: Update: Ver. EA 0.2.2
notes.content:
Hi all,

This is a minor update.  As I am considering the direction of how to add content, such as boss movement and stage designs, I have some little things fixed in this patch.  

- Large enemies now have a bigger collider box so less camera blocking 
- The main character now flashes red when he gets hit.  Similarly, enemies will flash teal when hit.  This should improve the situation read. 
- The saber swing sound is reworked.  However, still not good. sound work will be one of the things on the to-do list.  
- Building and obstacles now turn transparent when intervening with the camera.  
- The lighting is brighter now in most of the stages with the cost of some performance
- Some Buildings and backgrounds are baked into larger objects for better performance 

The current plan I made for the game is simple, keep working on it until I am happy with the quality.  That means I am aiming for full release by the end of the year, but if the project is not yet satisfying for me, it will be further postponed until it is made good. Sorry for the slow progression.  

-Brain Hack Magic

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/15f669fc5faa227b09944975f4a9e117545cd86b.png[/img]

notes.title: Developer Log: New Stages
notes.content:
For the friends waiting for updates, here is a teaser for the next update with the main topic I am working on.   

1.  Better stage.  The current states are short and serve as a proof of concept for the art style.  Now with the wall running and the AI can navigate in 3D. Better stages are on the way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/3f4999a68df87c2cd99ea84379d2745cb4286872.png[/img]


2.  Solidifying the core.  The core is the combat. The 3D building and pathway make the combats and camera control a little weird.  But in any case, the combat should be front and center.  More tuning is on its way. 

3.  More fun enemies.  Some new enemies while the current enemies are being upgraded to more exciting move sets and unique skills, especially the bosses.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/c867951c0e130dcef2b006b31f43fe8c08633e1b.png[/img]

Overall since few of the points are tied together, this update will take a little longer.  Let me know what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43902949/15f669fc5faa227b09944975f4a9e117545cd86b.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Update: 0.2.0, A step into the 3D world!
notes.content:
Sorry for taking so long for this update.  I am taking some bigger steps in this one.  It is still an ongoing effort and certainly not done yet, only the intro and data center stage are actually updated to the 3D platform.   More is coming, let me know what you think!

- The main character can now wall-running.  You can run along the wall horizontally or vertically for a short time and then jump off the wall. This allows dramatic 3D parkour freedom for the platforming. 
- The main character jumping and landing movements are now much more smooth to help the parkour feel. 
- Rolling and parry now can cancel any motion at any time on the floor. 
- Katana and firearms are now faster.
- Enemies AI overhaul, the AI is now can aim up/down
- Enemies AI can now jump up/down the platform 
- Enemies AI now running/attacking much more aggressively 
- Enemies AI can navigate any 3D space without a pre-map graph (sometimes a little glitchy at this moment.  Making AI to recognizing 3D space without any map graph is harder than I thought.  )
- Wall running/jump added into the tutorial (recommend you to see it)
- Datacenter stage remake with 3D stage design.  (Other stages should follow later versions)
- Fixed an issue with high refresh rate monitors making enemies twitching, theoretically, I don't have a high-speed monitor to test, uniformly.  

As almost everyone test played the game says, just corridors with enemies are not enough.  So,  I want to try some megaman-style enemy/platform in which the platforming is tightly integrated with your moving/fighting strategy and not just a map for you to run around and find some coins. 

It is definitely rushed, as always.  But I will keep working on it until it makes me happy.   Let me know what you think!  

Brain Hack Magic

notes.title: Update: Early Access 0.1.4
notes.content:
Hi all,

Here is another minor update to improve the core game mechanism before I begin to expand the stage design.  

- New mechanism: backstabbing,  attacking enemies from the back now deal double damage and double shield damage.  This mechanism makes dancing with the AI slightly more fun.  

- Katana X1 X2 X3 Y5 remake.  Now the moves are more natural and responsive.  (more remakes will be done to gauntlet and guns later)

- Enemies are now bending back while getting hit, this improves the striking feeling. 

- Screen shake magnitude can now be adjusted in the setting

-Graphical quality for resolution < 1080p has now defaulted to medium, which is the setting I tested with Steam deck and it works well!!

- Tutorial is slightly changed to show backstabbing

- Basic special moves are now unlocked from the beginning and introduced with backstabbing  since they are synergetic




I am still figuring out how to make keyboard and mouse work for the game.  Currently, I made the mouse link with the camera. And everything else can be key bind with the steam control setting. Meaning even without the official support, the game now can be played with a keyboard and mouse through this get around . 


The current goal is to push a larger update before the 7/4 sales. Let me know if you have any interesting ideas!


- Brain Hack Magic

notes.title: Update: Early Access 0.1.3
notes.content:
Here is a minor update that addresses some of the obvious flaws.  Also sharing some of the road map directions I am planning. 

Update:
- Video Option:  Frame Rate Target is now available.  
- Video Option: Quality Setting is now available.  (I am not sure if this helps the steam deck implementation)
- Audio Option: Music Volume is now there
- Audio Option: SFX Volume
- Enemy AI:  Minions are now more aggressive
- Enemy AI: All emails now show a red glowing eye halo effect before attacks
- Screen shake 

I hope those changes make the combat slightly more fun and reactive. But to make the combat really good, I am making a larger plan to address that. 


Roadmap:

1. Rework the sound effect, the current sound effect is pretty bad, and I believe it hurt the experience. I will make it my top priority

2. Game mechanism.  
- Boss interaction mechanism needs a lot more love
- Stage design needs a lot more work 
- I am working on many exciting ideas for the upgrading system
- Smart and fun AI



It might be slow, but I will not stop until the game is worth the love that all you give. 

Thank you so much!


-Brain Hack Magic

Again, those are quick fixes.  

Hope you have fun!

-Brain Hack Magic
